G12's taxpayer (alta 15 January 2025, no employment, no activity in 2024, a new activity in its first positive period, EU and US clients, VC) has closed Q1: 6,000 invoiced and 345.33 spent, the 205.33 of RETA cuotas included. setAside.oracleRef: Arithmetic under the set-aside composition rules of #10 and #15, computed by an independent Decimal script written from those rules and the sources below, not by running the engine. Actuals are the cumulative closed quarters; the projection is spread evenly over the months after the last of them. TGSS: LGSS art. 308.1.c (boe.es consolidated RDL 8/2015, read 2026-09-26): rendimiento computable = IRPF net plus the titular's cuotas, so the actual net with the cuotas charged to date added back (priced at the highest tramo consistent with the net they lead to) plus the projected net, averaged over the months of alta; tarifa plana 80 for the alta month and the twelve complete calendar months after it, Ley 20/2007 art. 38 ter.1 (boe.es consolidated text, read 2026-09-26); the month of alta prorated by days of alta / 30 as MonthlyCuotaCalculator does (#7). Modelo 130: AEAT instrucciones del modelo 130 (sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es, page updated 11 Sep 2026, read 2026-09-26), casillas 01–19, and RD 439/2007 art. 30.2ª and 110 (difícil justificación in casilla 02; casilla 12 floors 07 at zero; casilla 14 = 12 − 13 may be negative; casilla 15 deducts earlier negative casilla 19 results, at most a positive casilla 14). Annual: SPEC-002 steps 1, 2, 4 and 6, LIRPF art. 19, 20, 30.2.4ª, 32.3, 56, 63 and 74, VC mínimo 6,105 (Ley 13/1997 art. 2 bis). Hold-back share (Σ 130 + gap + Σ cuotas SS) / annual ingresos, rounded up to 0.0001. No AEAT simulator, published example or gestor covers a set-aside estimate; this is the weakest gate. Q1 is taken as stated: casilla 03 6,000 − (345.33 + 282.7335) = 5,371.94, 20 % 1,074.39, minoración 100, pays 974.39. Q2 to date: ingresos 6,000 + 27,000 × 3 / 9 = 15,000, gastos 345.33 + 900 × 3 / 9 + 240 of cuotas = 885.33; difícil justificación 705.7335; casilla 03 13,408.94; 20 % 2,681.79 − 1,074.39 = 1,607.40, less 100 = 1,507.40, due 1–20 July. Q3 and Q4 pay 1,507.40 each; Σ 130 5,496.59.
